title: Show login option first on application startup

requirements.text: Modify the application entry point to present the login/authentication option immediately when users first access the application, before showing any other content or features.
acceptanceCriteria: When users access the application for the first time, they see a login prompt or authentication interface before the main content
The login interface is prominently displayed and clearly guides users to authenticate via Internet Identity
After successful authentication, users proceed to the main application content (doubts feed, role setup, etc.)
Unauthenticated users cannot access main application features without logging in first

constraints: Must use existing Internet Identity authentication system
Do not modify the useInternetIdentity hook or authentication logic
Preserve existing routing structure and navigation once authenticated
nonGoals: Changing the authentication provider from Internet Identity
Modifying the role setup flow after login
